status: complete

All 4 checks ran live on this machine (arm64 / Apple M1 / macOS 27.2, uid 501, `TMPDIR=/var/folders/…/T/`, system python 3.14.8). No repo files modified; throwaway scripts under `/tmp/cyv-sock-verify/`; only light packages (pytest 9.1.1 + numpy) installed into `/tmp/cyv-sock-verify/venv` — no torch.

## Per-check results

**Check 1 — peer_uid() returns own uid on darwin: PASS**
- `python3 /tmp/cyv-sock-verify/check1_peeruid.py` → `platform: darwin`, `peer_uid(a)=501, peer_uid(b)=501`, own uid 501, via `socketpair`. Confirms the darwin branch constants are correct (`SOL_LOCAL=0`, `LOCAL_PEERCRED=0x001`, 76-byte xucred, `=II` unpack) — `src/cyvd/server/peercred.py:10-19`.

**Check 2 — long-HOME fallback + 0700 perms: PASS**
- Normal `CYV_HOME=/Users/sachinkoli/.cyv` → sock path 36 chars. With 120-char `CYV_HOME`, `run_dir()` → `/var/folders/…/T/cyv-501` (i.e. `$TMPDIR/cyv-<uid>/`), sock 66 bytes — fits mac sun_path (104 incl. NUL). Fallback math: `HOME` longer than 86 chars triggers it (`_MAX_SOCK_PATH=100`, `src/cyv/paths.py:9,36-41`).
- `ensure_private_dir` created the fallback dir mode `0o700`, and a real `bind()` on the fallback socket succeeded (`check2b_perms_bind.py`). (Socket file itself showed default-umask mode in the raw-bind probe; the daemon path separately forces `0600` via umask+chmod — see check 4.)

**Check 3 — existing daemon tests without torch: PASS (21/21)**
- `PYTHONPATH=src /tmp/cyv-sock-verify/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_daemon_client.py -v` → `21 passed in ~7.5s` (real spawn, say/convert, idle-exit/respawn, SIGTERM, stale-socket, version-mismatch — all in `--fake` mode, no models).
- torch-gated files (`test_components.py`, `test_integration.py`, `test_packs.py` — `pytest.importorskip("torch")`) were identified but not run; torch was deliberately not installed.

**Check 4 — server enforces peer-uid: YES, at the top of every connection**
- `src/cyvd/server/main.py:51-54` in `Daemon.handle`: `peer_uid(sock) != self.uid` → log + early return (no reply, connection closed). Import at `main.py:19`, baseline `self.uid = os.getuid()` at `main.py:44`.
- Live proof: server-side accepted socket reported peer uid 501 (`check4_server_side.py` PASS); with `peer_uid` monkeypatched to a foreign uid the client got connection-closed with no reply (`IncompleteReadError`, `check_reject.py` PASS, server logged "rejected connection from foreign uid").

## Gaps vs DESIGN §4.3

1. **Tests are Linux-oriented (confirmed):** `tests/test_daemon_client.py:31-36` — `pid_alive()` reads `/proc/<pid>/stat`; `/proc` does not exist on macOS, so the `open()` raises `OSError` and it returns `False` unconditionally. Any assertion of the form "wait until not pid_alive" therefore passes vacuously here (idle-exit, shutdown, SIGTERM tests). The socket-file-exists assertions in the same tests are still real. No test covers `peercred.py`'s darwin branch or the `run_dir()` fallback.
2. **Otherwise DESIGN §4.3 matches code:** flock-spawn + health wait (`src/cyv/client/core.py:108-147,174`), one retry on reset (`core.py:245`), idle exit only when `active==0` and work lock free (`main.py:132-140`), SIGTERM/SIGINT → cleanup with stale-socket inode + pid guards (`main.py:195-216`), 0700 run dir / 0600 socket+pid (`paths.py:44-48`, `main.py:181-190`), `LOCAL_PEERCRED` check.

## Open questions / suggested follow-ups

- Consider a macOS `pid_alive` (e.g. `os.kill(pid, 0)` + zombie check via `ps`, or `subprocess`) and a small darwin test for `peer_uid` + fallback so the suite actually guards §4.3 on Mac.
- Reconfirm on a long-username Mac that `$TMPDIR/cyv-<uid>/cyvd.sock` stays < 104 bytes (here: 66).
